title: Who is Verina? Wuthering Waves
sources: https://wutheringwaves.kurogames.com official news 676 'Profile Reveal: Nature Calling — Verina': extensive knowledge of botany; always smiling, wishing for every flower to be blessed with the miracle of life. Key art: Plant Breeder; 'If you come across any plants that pique your interest, do let me know!' Affiliation Jinzhou, Attribute Spectro

Official news 676 lore images: Anecdote from the Mountains (strange sounds from the mountain at night; villagers feared a Tacet Discord, went armed and found a girl digging holes to plant Dim Orchids; 'The flowers told me they want to settle on a slope with moonlight and moist winds'; weeks later the slope glowed with blossoming Dim Orchids); Shy Caretaker (memorized every teammate by plant names, e.g. 'That tall big guy needs a lot of water like Coral Oats'; once called a teammate by their plant name and blushed); Starflower (starflowers grow from her ears and back, withering in sadness or embarrassment and blooming in joy); Plants' Talk ('Plants talk in a silent and sincere language. I can translate their talk for you, if you want.')
Five-star rarity and healer role: per the game's character listing
Art: official Kuro Games images, cropped only (see presskit/SOURCE.txt), credited on screen

scenes.narration: If you find any plants that pique your interest, she'd love to know. This is Verina, the plant breeder, in Wuthering Waves.
One night, villagers heard strange sounds on the mountain. Expecting a Tacet Discord, they went up armed, and found a girl planting orchids.
The flowers told me they want moonlight, she explained. Weeks later, the whole slope was glowing with blossoms.
She remembers her teammates by plant names. The tall guy who drinks a lot of water? Coral Oats. She once called him that out loud, and blushed.
Starflowers grow from her ears and back. They bloom when she's happy, and wither when she's sad or embarrassed.
She says plants talk in a silent, sincere language, and she can translate for you. She's a five-star Spectro healer.
So, what would your plant nickname be? Tell me in the comments.
